answer: Behavioral comet-tail clustering. Each identity accrues a long-lived trace of timing and interaction fingerprints; after the fact, detection fits per-agent tails and flags clusters whose traces share a common origin. A ferrous weight discounts traces already linked to flagged clusters, so reuse lowers the score. Attacker cost: every fresh identity must build an independent trace over a delta of many epochs, multiplying effort per surviving sybil.
